text: Cooking is an enjoyable art that can transform everyday ingredients into a culinary spectacle. Garlic, a potent and aromatic spice, is often the first addition to many dishes, adding a bold and savory flavor. Then, onions, a fundamental ingredient, are introduced to balance the garlic's intensity, creating a harmonious flavor profile that enhances the overall taste of the dish. In various cuisines, garlic and onions are essential, from Italian pasta to Asian stir-fries, bringing depth and warmth to every meal.
